title: private-deployment-pegasus-weekly-sync-2026-03-03
content:
Pegasus private deployment - weekly sync notes (2026-03-03)

Attendees:
- Emily Zhang (Redwood)
- Liam O'Connor (Redwood Solutions)
- Priya Desai (Pegasus IT lead)
- Marcus Allen (Pegasus infra)
- Sofia Martinez (Redwood SRE)

Objective:
Quick status check on VPC/on-prem milestones and surface current blockers and owners. Align action items for next week.

Overall status summary:
- Project health: Yellow \u2014 still on the critical path for network and KMS verification.
- % complete (rough): 60% of infra/installer steps validated; major outstanding items are routing, KMS access from instances, and GPU driver mismatch on customer nodes.

Updates by area:
1) Networking / VPC peering- Status: Peering established between Pegasus VPC (10.2.0.0/16) and Redwood transit VPC in us-west-2.
- Blocker: Route table for private-subnet-2 not updated to include peering route; instances in that subnet cannot reach control plane.
- Owner: Liam O'Connor / Priya Desai to coordinate on route update.
- Notes: Pegasus network team confirmed peering accepted 2026-03-02 but forgot to push route table change to the private route table.

2) KMS & Secrets- Status: Pegasus provisioned a customer-managed KMS key and shared key ARN.
- Blocker: IAM role for node instances lacks kms:Decrypt permission scoped to the key alias; Redwood installer cannot unwrap bootstrap secrets.
- Owner: Emily Zhang to provide exact IAM policy snippet; Priya to apply and confirm.

3) On-prem / Node configuration- Status: Customer has three GPU nodes online but Triton process fails on startup.
- Blocker: NVidia driver version on nodes (525.x) incompatible with the requested CUDA runtime used by the image (CUDA 12).
- Owner: Marcus Allen (Pegasus) to schedule node driver update with hardware vendor; Redwood can provide a compatibility matrix.

4) Installer & Image pull / Proxy- Status: Helm chart applied; pods in CrashLoopBackOff in proxy environment.
- Blocker: Outbound HTTP proxy is rewriting TLS SNI, preventing image pulls from Redwood registry. Pegasus proxy needs exception/whitelist for registry domains and proper TLS passthrough.
- Owner: Liam O'Connor + Pegasus network team.

5) Observability & metrics- Status: Logs forwarded to S3 gateway; Datadog API key format mismatch causing metric forwarder to fail.
- Owner: Sofia Martinez to triage forwarder logs; Priya to confirm Datadog API key format.

6) Security & compliance- Status: Pegasus requested 13 months audit log retention and a list of accessed KMS keys per instance.
- Action: Redwood to share current audit retention options and roadmap for extended retention. Owner: Emily Zhang.

Milestones & upcoming dates:
- Network & KMS verification complete (Milestone M1) \u2014 target 2026-03-10
- Smoke tests (end-to-end inference on private cluster) \u2014 target 2026-03-17
- Production cutover readiness review (internal + Pegasus) \u2014 target 2026-04-01

Open blockers (priority ordering):
1) Route table update for private-subnet-2 (blocks control plane access) \u2014 Owner: Priya Desai \u2014 Due: 2026-03-05
2) IAM policy for KMS decrypt on instance role \u2014 Owner: Emily Zhang (provide snippet) / Priya Desai (apply) \u2014 Due: 2026-03-06
3) NVidia driver incompatibility on GPU nodes \u2014 Owner: Marcus Allen \u2014 Due: 2026-03-09 (vendor scheduled update)
4) Registry TLS passthrough / proxy whitelist \u2014 Owner: Liam O'Connor / Pegasus network team \u2014 Due: 2026-03-06
5) Datadog forwarder API key format fix \u2014 Owner: Sofia Martinez / Priya Desai \u2014 Due: 2026-03-08

Decisions made in this meeting:
- Proceed with smoke tests in a staged manner: run smaller inference jobs on subnet-1 once network routes validated, hold full load tests until drivers updated.
- Redwood will provide temporary guidance for a fallback image (CPU-only) for quick functional tests if GPU nodes unavailable by 2026-03-09.

Action items (owner -> task -> due):
- Priya Desai -> Update route table for private-subnet-2 to include peering route and confirm connectivity to control plane (10.2.0.0/16 <-> Redwood transit) -> Due 2026-03-05
- Emily Zhang -> Share exact IAM policy snippet and example cloud-init to attach kms:Decrypt permission to instance role -> Due 2026-03-04
- Marcus Allen -> Coordinate vendor maintenance window and update NVidia drivers to match CUDA12 runtime; report back with new driver version -> Due 2026-03-09
- Liam O'Connor -> Work with Pegasus proxy team to whitelist registry domains and enable TLS passthrough; validate image pulls -> Due 2026-03-06
- Sofia Martinez -> Debug Datadog forwarder logs and confirm required key format; file short runbook -> Due 2026-03-08
- Emily Zhang -> Share audit log retention options and technical constraints with Pegasus security -> Due 2026-03-10

Risks / contingency:
- If NVidia driver updates are delayed beyond 2026-03-09, we will run CPU-only smoke tests and delay full perf runs.
- If KMS access cannot be applied to instance role, we will fallback to container-side secret provisioning (temporary) with additional monitoring and a security exception ticket.

Notes / follow-ups for Redwood engineering:
- Provide compatibility matrix for driver/CUDA/container images (Emily)
- Produce a one-page network checklist for Pegasus network team to make route + firewall changes predictable (Liam)

Next sync:
- Weekly sync scheduled: 2026-03-10 10:00 PT
- Proposed agenda: verify route + KMS changes, confirm driver update status, run initial smoke tests if green.

Quick reference links:
- Runbook (Confluence): CONFLUENCE: peg-pegasus-deployment-runbook
- JIRA: JIRA-6123 (networking), JIRA-6127 (drivers)
- GH PR: redwood/private-deploy-config PR#78

Notes to self (Emily):
- Draft the IAM policy snippet ASAP and paste into Jira comment for Priya.
- Prepare CPU-only smoke test script as fallback and upload to GH in case drivers slip.

End of notes.
